name: Tinker AFB
description: Home of the 72nd Air Base Wing and Air Force Sustainment Center. Major depot maintenance and logistics hub supporting aircraft sustainment for the Air Force.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

resources.name: Tinker Dining Facility
resources.description: Primary DFAC with full meal service and flight meals.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri: Breakfast 0630-0830, Lunch 1100-1300, Dinner 1700-1900; Sat-Sun adjusted hours

resources.name: Tinker Main Exchange (BX)
resources.description: Full-service Exchange with retail, services, and food court.

resources.name: Tinker Federal Credit Union
resources.description: On-base federal credit union with 24/7 ATM access.

resources.name: Main BX ATM (24/7)
resources.description: 24/7 ATM located at the Main Exchange.

resources.name: Tinker Fitness Center
resources.description: Main fitness facility with cardio, weights, group exercise, racquetball, and basketball. 24/7 access for registered users.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0500-2200; Sat-Sun 0800-1800; 24/7 for registered CAC holders

resources.name: Tinker Inn / AF Lodging
resources.description: Official temporary lodging and TLF. 24-hour front desk.
resources.hours: Lodging desk open 24 hours daily; check-in 1400, check-out 1100

resources.name: Military & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation, financial counseling, employment support, family programs, and Total Force readiness.

resources.name: 72nd Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: Full MWR, dining, fitness, lodging, recreation, and family support programs.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0730-1630; facility hours on FSS website directory

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation (ODR)
resources.description: Equipment rental, RV storage, FamCamp, and recreational programs.

resources.name: Tinker Golf Course
resources.description: 18-hole golf course with pro shop and dining.

resources.name: Tinker Medical Clinic
resources.description: Primary care, specialty services, and TRICARE support.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Dormitory Management (405-739-5218) for unaccompanied housing or Tinker Inn (405-739-3311) for temporary lodging. Family housing through privatized housing office.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 72 FSS, M&FRC, and official Tinker sites for in-processing and community support.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit MPF within required timelines. Contact base lodging for after-hours arrivals.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival. Contact M&FRC if no sponsor is assigned before departure.
